parts.summary: Two students discuss project planning and assignment preparation during a college study-skills session.

questionGroups.title: Questions 21-25
questionGroups.instructions: Choose the correct answer A, B, C, or D.

questions.prompt: What is the main problem the students mention at the start of the seminar?

options.label: They leave assignments until too late.
They cannot access the course website.

options.label: Write the final conclusion immediately.

options.label: They work long hours at part-time jobs.

parts.title: Time management lecture
parts.summary: A lecturer explains how students can manage deadlines more effectively.

questionGroups.title: Questions 31-40
questionGroups.instructions: Choose the correct answer A, B, C, or D.

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the lecture?

options.label: Time management for students
How to improve note-taking speed
The design of university libraries
How to choose optional modules

questions.prompt: According to the lecturer, students should start by trying to

options.label: understand how they currently use their time
work faster
set an overview of their assignment
plan every task in exact detail immediately

questions.prompt: The lecturer says students often make the mistake of trying to

options.label: organise everything in an over-systematic way
work faster
set an overview of their assignment

questions.prompt: In this college, students are assigned ____________ at the end of each semester.

options.label: team projects
final term examinations
essays

questions.prompt: One sign the lecturer mentions that students feel under pressure is

options.label: library books go missing

questions.prompt: What kind of suggestion does the lecturer give to the students?

options.label: Making a very detailed plan of their daily activities
Not being so stressed just because there is an assignment
